issue.title: Symlinked project alias dirs are indexed twice, duplicating agent rows in the fleet catalog
issue.description:
The agent artifact scanner follows symlinked entries in the projects root, so a
project directory reachable through an alias symlink is indexed once per path.

On apollo, `~/.sase/projects/sase` is a symlink to `gh_sase-org__sase` (created
2026-09-09). `agent_artifact_index.sqlite` held two `agent_artifacts` rows for
every agent in that project: one with `project_name = 'sase'` and one with
`project_name = 'gh_sase-org__sase'`, both describing the same artifact
directory with the same `cl_name`. The owner gateway's fleet catalog then served
each agent twice to remote viewers; athena's ACE showed 4 rows for 2 agents.

Project lifecycle code already treats such an entry as not a real project
(`_resolve_deletable_project_dir` rejects a symlinked project dir as "not an
actual project directory"), so the scan and index should skip or canonicalize
symlinked project entries instead of materializing duplicate rows. Decide
whether symlinked aliases are a supported layout before choosing between
skipping them and deduplicating by real path.

task_type_fields.impact:
Every agent in an aliased project is duplicated in remote fleet views and in any
index consumer that does not deduplicate by real path, doubling rows, counts,
and per-row work such as owner liveness probes and dismissal-lineage lookups.
On apollo it doubled the stale remote rows athena's ACE displayed.
task_type_fields.repro:
1. In a SASE home with at least one agent under
   `projects/<name>/artifacts/ace-run/...`, add an alias symlink:
   `ln -s <name> ~/.sase/projects/<alias>`.
2. Rebuild the index: `sase agent index rebuild`.
3. Count rows per agent timestamp:
   `sqlite3 ~/.sase/agent_artifact_index.sqlite "select timestamp, group_concat(project_name), count(*) from agent_artifacts group by timestamp having count(*) > 1 limit 5"`
   Every agent in the aliased project appears twice, once per project name.
4. On an enrolled remote, the gateway presentation catalog returns one summary
   per indexed path, so every such agent shows up twice in the controller's
   Agents tab.
